description: Look at letters and pictures with a grown-up. Tap the picture that starts with the sound.

tier.name: Starting support
tier.range: Classroom support choice; not a WIDA proficiency level

A.studentGoal: I can match a letter sound to a picture.

info.headline: I can match a letter sound to a picture.
info.summary: First sounds, read aloud by the device or a grown-up.
canDo: I can match a letter sound to a picture.

activities.title: Starts with S
activities.skill: Matching a first sound to a picture
activities.directions: Listen to the sound sss. Tap the picture that starts with sss.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha el sonido sss. Toca el dibujo que empieza con sss.
vocabulary: a mark we use to write words
letra: signo que usamos para escribir
activities.hint: Tap a sentence to hear it. Read it with your finger under each word.
activities.support: Tap a sentence to hear it. Read it with your finger under each word.
activities.extension: Read the sentences again to a grown-up or a stuffed animal.
wida: Connect a letter sound to a word

teacher.use: With a grown-up beside the child. The grown-up may tap the speaker, point, and repeat; the child answers by pointing or saying a word.
teacher.function: Matching a first sound to a picture
teacher.lower: Read each sentence aloud together while pointing to each word.
teacher.onLevel: The child reads first, taps only the words they need, then answers.
teacher.challenge: Ask the child to find and read the sentence that proves the answer.
teacher.noTech: Write the sentences on chart paper and draw the choices on cards.
teacher.prompt: Which sentence helped you? Read it to me.
